datasets.title: Aruba: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Aruba: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/aruba-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

contact_point.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were created by applying machine learning to satellite imagery to identify building footprints, then overlaying population estimates derived from census data and demographic statistics at the building level. The resulting gridded datasets represent spatial distributions of total population and seven demographic subgroups across Aruba at approximately 100m resolution.

sources.name: Facebook Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial framework for population distribution modeling

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology that overlays census data and publicly available demographic statistics onto building-level spatial units
